question: 逐属性 Agent A/B 生成、EVM 回放通过的种子，是否提升原生 Echidna 的覆盖或反例发现效率；计入种子生成时间后是否仍有优势。
eligible_pool_source: deepseek/结果/自主种子质量实验/*-Slither属性.json 与对应 *-Harness编译.json；仅用已缓存 Slither 报告，不重跑分析。
inclusion_rules: 真实项目 Harness 中存在可由当前 Echidna 运行的零参数 property/assertion 函数。
该属性存在于状态完整的缓存 Slither 报告，且对应 Harness 有现存编译 ABI/bytecode。
固定样本在首次 Agent API 调用前确定；不按 Agent 产物、EVM 成败或 Echidna 结果替换属性。
type_rules: 权限控制：函数或状态明确检查授权主体、角色或未授权调用结果。
状态依赖：断言依赖先前交易写入/更新的状态或多个合约间的一致状态。
数值边界/会计：cap、守恒、余额/储备一致或 supply accounting 数值关系。
多交易序列：属性机制需要先建立状态，再经历至少两个有序动作；Drips assertion 属此类。可多标签。
screening_selection_rule: 从现存且当前 Echidna 可运行的真实 Harness 中固定 10 条，覆盖 4 类属性、3 个真实项目。重复样本在任何筛选结果产生前指定为每类一个具体代表，全部进入重复集，不因种子失败或覆盖表现替换属性。Drips 参数化 assertion 因 Echidna 明确拒绝带参 test 函数，在模型调用前排除并记录；用新的零参数 commit/reveal 属性替代。

properties.selection_reason: 零参数多阶段 commit/reveal 属性；按属性类型选择，本轮重新生成以统一生成过程。

repetition_selection.reason: 预先指定的权限绕过代表属性
预先指定的跨操作状态属性
预先指定的额度上限属性
预先指定的两阶段 commit/reveal 代表属性；本轮重新生成，不复用已知种子。

excluded_candidates.reason: 与已纳入的 investor cap 同属数值 mint cap，按预设去冗余规则只留一个。
与 token1 conserved 同为代币守恒/会计关系，按预设去冗余规则不重复采样。
与 reserves match balances 均检查池状态关系，按预设去冗余规则不重复采样。
Echidna 2.3.2 预检在 Agent 调用前拒绝带六个参数的 assertion test 函数；不改上游 Harness，因此不具备当前原生属性运行条件。完整日志保留在 preflight-final/Drips/.../echidna.log。

conditions.baseline: 原生 Echidna，隔离的空 coverage 目录，不注入外部种子。
conditions.v2: 逐属性 Agent A 规划、Agent B 具体化、最多一次 planning repair 与一次 EVM feedback repair；只有 EVM 有效种子进入 V2 主语料；失败属性仍运行对照并计入分母。

repeated_validation.seed_generation_time_basis: screening pair includes measured generation/replay time once; subsequent pairs reuse the same seed without recharging already-paid preparation time

conditions.coverage_metric: Echidna unique instructions; report absolute per-property delta and relative percentage delta.
conditions.violation_metric: Target-property counterexample indicator and first observed wall-clock time; EVM seed prevalidation violations counted separately and disclosed.
conditions.seed_metrics: Plan/candidate success and EVM-executable seed rate, with failed or timed-out attributes retained in the denominator.
conditions.known_scope: Fresh Slither compile/analysis is excluded from wall-clock budget because cached property analyses are reused.

pre_screening.drips_failure: Echidna 2.3.2 aborted because the assertion test function has arguments
pre_screening.failure_log: deepseek/结果/逐属性原生对照实验/扩展属性筛选-20261114/preflight-final/Drips/6e7899beaef22d4a3a87/echidna.log

amendments_before_agent_calls.change: Remove the Drips parameterized assertion from the screening sample and replace it with BeeStorage tracked commit/reveal; update the multi-transaction repeat representative.
amendments_before_agent_calls.reason: A zero-API Echidna 2.3.2 preflight rejected the Drips assertion because it has function arguments. The replacement follows the pre-registered property type and runtime compatibility, not Agent/EVM/fuzzing results. It will be freshly generated to avoid conditioning inclusion on an earlier seed.

amendments_before_agent_calls.change: Record each frozen property's Slither-linked versus generic ABI-fallback action inventory.
amendments_before_agent_calls.reason: A pre-call context audit found that some properties have no direct Slither action but do have cross-contract actions; the single remaining empty Slither relation receives a generic serializable mutator inventory. All ten attributes remain fixed and each has at least one callable action. No model output was observed.

amendments_before_agent_calls.change: After the first screening run, preserve two local preflight budget rejections and rerun those same frozen properties under the already-registered 30,000-token cap using compact, deduplicated dependency evidence.
amendments_before_agent_calls.reason: The initial Agent A requests had conservative UTF-8 upper bounds above the registered cap, so no API request was sent and no candidate was attempted for BeeStorage 2c68514fc72b1303d6e8 and a11cc51249256da90a47. A source-preserving prompt compaction was made; refreshed bounds are 26,783 and 26,794 tokens. No property, random seed, Echidna budget, or selection rule changes.
